topic: Someone discovers a hidden room in their new house
text: I found a small, nearly invisible gap behind the bookcase, a whisper of space that seemed out of place. My fingers traced the outline, and on a whim, I pushed. The wall gave way, a creaking sigh echoing as the bookshelf swung open to reveal a dark, narrow doorway. The air inside was thick and stagnant, carrying the scent of old paper and forgotten things. I fumbled for my phone, its light casting eerie shadows on the walls. Each step I took into the hidden room made the planks of the floor groan, as if the house itself was questioning my presence. The room was small, lined with shelves crammed with dusty journals and half-rotted books, their spines cracked and fragile. My breath caught, a mix of curiosity and something else, as I reached out to touch the nearest tome.
